calls.reason: This is a rhetorical claim about intent with no test. The only evidence is Meta hiring a bias adviser, which can be read as seeking neutrality, and there is nothing at all on Altman.

Rozado's 2024 PLOS ONE study and the 2025 Stanford study each tested 24 LLMs. Both found nearly all of them between neutral and left of center, with none clearly right. That differs in degree, but it is clustering.

The firm part holds. China's binding 2023 CAC Interim Measures (Article 4) require generative AI to follow core socialist values, and the regulator was testing models for this in 2024. The Russia and US parts are hedged.
A May 2025 study found Grok 3 variants mostly left-leaning, but it predates the target period and does not measure Musk's positions. The packet has no direct comparison.

Musk announced the plan to rewrite the corpus and retrain, but as of late 2025 reporting treated training Grok on rewritten data as only hypothetical. The forecast has no deadline and is not documented either way.
The ACL 2024 paper shows LLM opinions lack paraphrase robustness. But no study tests the claimed cause, and Rozado's preprint points to post-training rather than conflicting training data.
